svg.text: v9 HIGH-ALTITUDE BALLOON FLIGHT BOARD — SYSTEM DIAGRAM
Dual-band flight board. One HUB + four jettisonable WING boards (Variant A). Variant B = hub only, no wings, no cut, target < 20 g payload.
POWER — harvest → bypass → store → regulate → feed (NO BATTERY)
Amber arrows = direction of energy flow. Dashed boxes/arrows = not wired or TODO(unverified).
only W4_SOLAR_N sits on GND — the four
a cracked or shaded wing costs one wing,
defines VSCAP: the raw cap node (ADR-006)
D_CLAMP TVS sits here — set point TODO(unverified)
PVA1 + PVA2 cells (78 × 39 mm), in series
cutting a wing cannot kill the hub array
(ADR-051) — it has its own converter input
output rail TODO(unverified) — no net assigned
the 2 W PA cannot run off the 3V3 rail
that is why the PA is fed pre-regulator
VSCAP also powers the cut drivers
→ a cut fires with the converter dead
RADIO — three radio chips, four antennas, three bands
Two link directions on two separate chips, so TX and RX can be simultaneous — plus one ranging-only chip (ADR-034, ADR-060).
+33 dBm / 2 W at 5 V · 1100 mA burst
crystal only — NO TCXO, NO NTC
ANT4 → GNSS L1 receive · GNSS_VCC via R_F1 + C4
the radio's frequency error is MEASURED against it
and corrected in firmware (ADR-056 D3). No heater,
no OCXO, no extra gram. Routed to ESP32 GPIO21.
UART: GNSS_TX / GNSS_RX. GNSS is the authority — not the SX1280.
I2C: I2C_SCL / I2C_SDA to the ESP32
pressure + temperature for altitude and drift
DISCREPANCY — drawn as the schematic says
Support passives: R_DIV1/R_DIV2 monitor the bank (SCAP_ADC), R_BAL1/R_BAL2 balance the midpoint (SCAP_MID). R_F1 + C4 clean the GNSS rail.
R_MON1/R_MON2 sense the F33 rail (F33_VSENSE): 5.4 V ÷ 9.4 MΩ = 0.574 µA = 3.1 µW. C_BULK + C_HF carry the PA burst on F33_VCC.
COMPUTE & STORAGE — one module, nothing external
the module IS the storage — no external
IO35–IO37 are reserved for octal PSRAM
by the N8R8 (ADR-108) — not board GPIOs
flash 8 MB · PSRAM 8 MB, both on-die
survives power loss — this is the flight
no SD card / external flash / eMMC fitted;
SPI2 → U3 bare LoRa2021 (2.4 GHz RX)
I2C → U6 barometer · UART → U5 GNSS
Flash is the persistent log medium; PSRAM may only stage. The 46-part netlist contains no storage part other than U1 — that is the ADR-061 decision, not an omission.
CUT / SHED-TO-SURVIVE — 4 latched cut drivers, 4 wing sockets, nichrome elements
Cutting a wing sheds both its solar current path and its mass, so the vehicle survives descent. Each driver is fed from the raw cap node, so a cut still fires with the converter dead.
→ fires the nichrome cut element in wing 1
cut continuity sensed on the RF_FEED line
J_W1 pin 3 · net CUT_SENSE_W1 = J_W1.3 + U_CUT1.3
→ fires the nichrome cut element in wing 2
cut continuity sensed on the RF_FEED line
J_W2 pin 3 · net CUT_SENSE_W2 = J_W2.3 + U_CUT2.3
→ fires the nichrome cut element in wing 3
cut continuity sensed on the RF_FEED line
J_W3 pin 3 · net CUT_SENSE_W3 = J_W3.3 + U_CUT3.3
→ fires the nichrome cut element in wing 4
cut continuity sensed on the RF_FEED line
J_W4 pin 3 · net CUT_SENSE_W4 = J_W4.3 + U_CUT4.3

Cut ladder once the per-cut bypass V_f is included: 6.00 / 4.12 / 2.24 / 0.36 V — the vehicle survives ONE cut (ADR-054 §3.1). Cutting also sheds the wing's solar load, so the remaining string still feeds the radio.
Variant B has no wings and no cut: J_W1…J_W4, D_BP1…D_BP4 and U_CUT1…U_CUT4 stay on the board but unpopulated. The netlist carries the Variant-A superset and does not distinguish the two.
KEY NUMBERS — the short labels that matter
— F33 PA at 5 V → PRE-REGULATOR feed
— F33 only; bare LoRa2021 is crystal
— array must beat it from solar alone
frequency error is measured and corrected
wire dipoles on the HUB, so cutting a wing
block: a functional group, not a placement
• D_CLAMP set point; U4 VDD / RFIO pins
• R_NTC1 / TH_NTC1 DNP — no NTC path (ADR-059)
